comment: FilaMind Setup component catalog. Adding a component = one entry here, no engine change. 'type' selects how it installs/updates (git_repo / service install via git clone + install.sh; web / tauri / manual are catalog-only for now). 'manager_key' / 'service' / 'dir' refine install detection when a component's runtime name differs from its id.

components.name: Klipper
components.desc: 3D-printer firmware: the motion planner runs on the host and streams precisely-timed steps to the MCU.

components.name: Moonraker
components.desc: API server that exposes Klipper over HTTP/WebSocket so web UIs, apps and tools can talk to the printer.

components.name: FilaMind 3d
components.desc: FilaMind's web control interface for Klipper - the suite's primary printer UI.

components.name: Mainsail
components.desc: A web interface for Klipper, served as static files in the browser.

components.name: Fluidd
components.desc: A web interface for Klipper, served as static files in the browser.

components.name: KlipperScreen
components.desc: A touchscreen interface for Klipper that runs on the printer's own attached display.

components.name: Guppyscreen
components.desc: A lightweight native touchscreen UI for Klipper aimed at embedded displays.

components.name: FilaMind screen
components.desc: FilaMind's native touchscreen app for the printer's attached display.

components.name: FilaMind flow
components.desc: FilaMind's host-side widget app that adds tools and panels to your printer UI.

components.name: Crowsnest
components.desc: A webcam streaming manager that publishes MJPEG/HLS streams from the printer's cameras.

components.name: Spoolman
components.desc: A filament spool inventory that tracks remaining material and usage across your prints.

components.name: Mobileraker Companion
components.desc: Companion service for the Mobileraker mobile app that delivers print push-notifications.

components.name: OctoApp Companion
components.desc: Companion plugin that connects the printer to the OctoApp mobile app.

components.name: Obico for Klipper
components.desc: Connects the printer to Obico for AI-based failure detection and remote monitoring.

components.name: OctoEverywhere
components.desc: Free secure remote access, monitoring and notifications for the printer from anywhere.

components.name: SimplyPrint
components.desc: Connects the printer to the SimplyPrint cloud platform for remote management.

components.name: Adaptive Meshing & Purging (KAMP)
components.desc: Meshes only the area your print uses and lays a smart purge line - less wasted time and filament.

components.name: Klipper Backup
components.desc: Backs up your printer configuration to a Git repository on a schedule or on demand.

components.name: TMC Autotune
components.desc: Tunes TMC stepper-driver registers automatically from each motor's specifications.

components.name: Shake&Tune
components.desc: Resonance-measurement and input-shaping analysis tooling with detailed diagnostic graphs.

components.name: LED Effect
components.desc: Drives addressable LED strips with animated effects tied to printer state.

components.name: G-Code Shell Command
components.desc: Lets G-code macros run host shell commands - the building block for many add-ons.

components.name: PrettyGCode
components.desc: An interactive 3D G-code viewer for previewing toolpaths in the browser.

components.name: Moonraker Timelapse
components.desc: Records timelapse videos of prints by capturing a webcam frame each layer.

components.name: Moonraker Telegram Bot
components.desc: Reports print status and lets you control the printer through a Telegram chat bot.

components.name: Katapult (bootloader)
components.desc: A bootloader for Klipper MCUs that enables firmware flashing over USB, CAN or serial.

components.name: CAN-bus tools
components.desc: Command-line utilities for bringing up and flashing CAN-bus toolhead boards.
